'''Niquon's sanctuary''' was located in the mountains of [[Skalokor]], near to the [[Dolandu]] settlement of [[Stomorr]]. The [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Niquon]] lived there for some years, training his apprentice [[Nason Laric]]. The sanctuary had shielding that blocked communications signals. When a local Dolandu brought a malfunctioning droid to Niquon, the shielding meant that the droid was unable to transmit its position to its owner.<ref name="Jedi's Legacy">{{GamerCite|10|Jedi's Legacy}}</ref>
